# Training

`GeoTrainer(model, TrainingConfig(...)).fit(train, val)` is the training loop. The other classes supply the data, the
metrics, the optimiser and scheduler, checkpoints, distributed training, tracking and hyper-parameter search.

**Explained in:** [Training a model](../../training/index.md) · [The training configuration](../../training/config.md) · [Experiments](../../experiments/index.md)

This page documents **25 public classes and functions** in 11 modules.

## `pygeovision.training.metrics`

Geospatial evaluation metrics (Phase 4.4). IoU, F1, mAP, accuracy, confusion matrix for segmentation and detection.

| Name | Kind | What it is |
|---|---|---|
| `SegmentationMetrics` | class | Pixel-level segmentation metrics: mIoU, F1, accuracy, per-class IoU. |
| `DetectionMetrics` | class | Object detection metrics: mAP@50, mAP@50-95 and mAP@75 (needs torchmetrics + pycocotools). |
| `ChangeDetectionMetrics` | class | Binary change detection metrics: F1-change, precision, recall, IoU-change. |
